title: Samsung BB8700 — Manual check mode
description: Manual Smart Install — press Delay End to step components; Spin advances steps.

steps.title: Enter manual check
steps.body: From AS display: press Delay End to enter manual mode. Press Spin to advance: 1 door lock, 2 drain, 3 prep valve, Co cold, Ho hot, 6 water shot/heater/rinse, 7 drain, 8 spin, 9 dry heater/fan, 10 door.
